integrity: Analytic proof is exact; finite verifier checks support but do not replace all-parameter proof. No independent audit or external certification.
limitations: Exact Haar law only for central planes through positive diagonal images of the canonical rhombic dodecahedron. The anisotropy minimum is local modulo scale; no global theorem. Priority against inaccessible older stereology remains uncertain.
title: Exact Haar central-section law and quadratic anisotropy penalty for rhombic dodecahedra
